ui.teamBridge.holds.title.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Messages a teammate sent that the reader's screener (an AI check on this device) held back from the reader's agent.

ui.teamBridge.holds.intro.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Deliver and Discard are the button names; keep them matching the button translations. 'Screening' is the automatic check on this device that decides whether a message reaches the reader's agent. A teammate is a person; their agent is the AI agent acting for them. Device-neutral: never name Mac, Touch ID or a platform.

ui.teamBridge.holds.loading.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section.

ui.teamBridge.holds.load_failed.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Shown with a Retry button.

ui.teamBridge.holds.empty.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section.

ui.teamBridge.holds.release_off.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. A device setting turns the Deliver/Discard actions off. Device-neutral wording.

ui.teamBridge.holds.from_person.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Names the teammate who sent the held message.

ui.teamBridge.holds.from_agent.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. The message was written by a teammate's AI agent acting for that teammate.

ui.teamBridge.holds.unknown_sender.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. The sender could not be identified.

ui.teamBridge.holds.held_at.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section.

ui.teamBridge.holds.deliver_until.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. After this time only Discard remains.

ui.teamBridge.holds.unscreened.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Badge on a held message that no AI screening model read. The reason line beside it explains it.

ui.teamBridge.holds.reason.new_work.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Why the message was held. The screener judged that the message asks the reader's agent to start new work.

ui.teamBridge.holds.reason.review.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Why the message was held. Screening (the automatic check on this device) held the message for the reader to decide.

ui.teamBridge.holds.reason.unclear.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Why the message was held. Screening (the automatic check on this device) answered but its answer could not be used.

ui.teamBridge.holds.reason.not_screened.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Why the message was held. Every screening attempt failed; only Discard is offered.

ui.teamBridge.holds.reason.no_screener.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Why the message was held. No screening model could be reached; the device retries by itself.

ui.teamBridge.holds.reason.records.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Why the message was held. Internal stored records disagree; a safety hold. Keep it plain and non-alarming.

ui.teamBridge.holds.reason.unreadable.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Why the message was held. The message's content could not be verified against what was sent.

ui.teamBridge.holds.reason.waiting.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Why the message was held. A temporary wait on this device; nothing for the reader to do.

ui.teamBridge.holds.reason.other.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Why the message was held. Generic fallback for a reason this version does not know.

ui.teamBridge.holds.state.not_releasable.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. No Deliver or Discard is offered for this message.

ui.teamBridge.holds.state.deliver_expire.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. The delivery window has passed.

ui.teamBridge.holds.state.chose_deliver.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. The reader already pressed Deliver; Deliver matches the button.

ui.teamBridge.holds.state.chose_discard.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. The reader already pressed Discard; Discard matches the button.

ui.teamBridge.holds.state.not_applied.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. The recorded decision was refused when applied.

ui.teamBridge.holds.details_unavailable.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. The sender and content could not be read, so the buttons are not offered.

ui.teamBridge.holds.deliver.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Lets the reader's agent read the held message.

ui.teamBridge.holds.discard.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Drops the held message; the sender is told it was not delivered.

ui.teamBridge.holds.deliver_label.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. {sender} is the whole sender line, e.g. 'From Ana' or 'From Scout, Ana’s agent'. Do not add 'from' again.

ui.teamBridge.holds.discard_label.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. {sender} is the whole sender line, e.g. 'From Ana' or 'From Scout, Ana’s agent'. Do not add 'from' again.

ui.teamBridge.holds.refusal.release_off.role: error message under a held message
ui.teamBridge.holds.refusal.release_off.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. The device setting is off.

ui.teamBridge.holds.refusal.not_releasab.role: error message under a held message
ui.teamBridge.holds.refusal.not_releasab.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. This message cannot be acted on here.

ui.teamBridge.holds.refusal.stale.role: error message under a held message
ui.teamBridge.holds.refusal.stale.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. The message changed after it was shown.

ui.teamBridge.holds.refusal.already_deci.role: error message under a held message
ui.teamBridge.holds.refusal.already_deci.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Another decision was already recorded.

ui.teamBridge.holds.refusal.deliver_expi.role: error message under a held message
ui.teamBridge.holds.refusal.deliver_expi.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. The delivery window has passed.

ui.teamBridge.holds.refusal.signing_unav.role: error message under a held message
ui.teamBridge.holds.refusal.signing_unav.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. The device could not sign the decision. Device-neutral: never name Touch ID or a platform.

ui.teamBridge.holds.refusal.generic.role: error message under a held message
ui.teamBridge.holds.refusal.generic.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Fallback for an unknown error.

ui.teamBridge.holds.waiting_total.role: accessible count of the sidebar badge
ui.teamBridge.holds.waiting_total.note: Accessible name of the sidebar and Approvals badges when held messages are counted with approval requests. Keep the ICU plural arms.

ui.teamBridge.holds.from_agent_unnamed.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. An agent wrote this message but has no name; it must never read as the person's own words.

ui.teamBridge.holds.reason.action.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Why the message was held: a wait only the reader can clear (sign in, consent, setup).

ui.teamBridge.holds.reason.unscreened.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Explains the 'Not checked' badge: no AI model read the message. Deliver is still possible, so it asks the reader to read it first.

ui.teamBridge.holds.key_file_only.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Shown when this device's signing key is a plain file. Other software running under the same user account could also record a decision. Device-neutral: never name a platform.

ui.teamBridge.holds.cannot_verify.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. The shown text differs from what screening checked, so no buttons are offered.

ui.teamBridge.holds.hidden_characters.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. The message body carries invisible characters (for example Unicode tag or direction-control characters) that a person cannot see but an AI agent would read, so only Discard is offered. Deliver and Discard match the button names. Do not imply the sender is malicious.

ui.teamBridge.holds.body_withheld.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. The message text was withheld, so only Discard is possible. Deliver and Discard match the button names.

ui.teamBridge.holds.read_first.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Deliver appears only after the reader opens the whole message.

ui.teamBridge.holds.show_full.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Expands a long message to its full text.

ui.teamBridge.holds.show_full_attachment.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Expands the message and shows its attachments.

ui.teamBridge.holds.show_less.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Collapses the expanded message.

ui.teamBridge.holds.confirm.deliver.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Second step before Deliver. States the consequence. Not an OS prompt.

ui.teamBridge.holds.confirm.discard.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Second step before Discard. States the consequence.

ui.teamBridge.holds.confirm.deliver_acti.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Confirms Deliver.

ui.teamBridge.holds.confirm.discard_acti.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Confirms Discard.

ui.teamBridge.holds.confirm.cancel.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Leaves the confirmation without deciding.

ui.teamBridge.holds.delivering.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Shown on the pressed button while Deliver is recorded.

ui.teamBridge.holds.discarding.note: Team Bridge Approvals, Held messages section. Shown on the pressed button while Discard is recorded.
